# NSCLC

```{r}
# Adjust the path if needed
res <- readRDS("./giotto/NSCLC_res.rds")
res$PI<-abs(res$PI)

# ---- processing ----
res_processed <- res %>%
  # 1) keep only p.adj >= 0.05 (i.e., remove rows with p.adj < 0.05)
  filter(p.adj >= 0.05) %>%
  
  # 2) normalize PI within each ligand–receptor pair
  group_by(ligand, receptor) %>%
  mutate(
    sum_PI = sum(PI, na.rm = TRUE),
    PI_norm = ifelse(sum_PI > 0, PI / sum_PI, 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-sum_PI)

# 3) summarize to sender (rows) × receiver (cols) by averaging normalized PI
sender_receiver_avg <- res_processed %>%
  group_by(lig_cell_type, rec_cell_type) %>%
  summarise(PI_avg = mean(PI_norm, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  # 4) pivot to wide matrix-like table
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = rec_cell_type,
    values_from = PI_avg,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# convert to a proper numeric matrix (rownames = sender / lig_cell_type)
mat_res <- as.data.frame(sender_receiver_avg)
rownames(mat_res) <- mat_res$lig_cell_type
mat_res <- as.matrix(mat_res[ , setdiff(names(mat_res), "lig_cell_type"), drop = FALSE])

# ---- output: CSV ----
dir.create("./giotto", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
# write.csv preserves row names (sender cell types)
write.csv(mat_res, file = "./giotto/NSCLC.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```
